idle: Paste a destination URL. Page details can suggest a title and key; you can edit both.
loading: Looking up page details… You can create the link while this finishes.
ready: Page suggestions are ready. Your own edits are kept.
unavailable: Page details could not be loaded. Enter a title yourself or create the link without one.
copied: Link created and copied to your clipboard.
copyDenied: Link created. Automatic copying was unavailable; use Copy to copy its address.
